environment.description: Amazon Linux 2 EC2 instance running the SQS consumer as a systemd service under the 'appuser' account. SELinux is in permissive mode (setenforce 0 was set during deployment troubleshooting and never reverted). The process has standard DAC permissions with write access to /var/lib/oauth/tokens/ and the appuser has supplementary group membership allowing writes to /etc/cron.d/ and /tmp/. No AppArmor profile loaded (Amazon Linux uses SELinux). SQS queue is publicly subscribable with IAM policy allowing SendMessage from any authenticated AWS principal.

config.sqs_policy: open SendMessage to any authenticated principal
